top_categories.workout_context: 85ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Homegrown Gravel Adventure, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Homegrown Gravel Adventure's Georgia-Alabama border gravel, Pavé and dirt forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 100 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Homegrown Gravel Adventure. Train it until it feels boring.
At mile 60 of 100, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Homegrown Gravel Adventure's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before February.
8,500ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Homegrown Gravel Adventure, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
8,500ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
Low-cadence force work for 8,500ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 100 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
100 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Homegrown Gravel Adventure’s 100 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Homegrown Gravel Adventure requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on steep georgia-alabama border gravel to build confidence. Expect: georgia-alabama border gravel, pavé and dirt, sand and stream crossings.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Over Under, and Gravel Specific to prepare you for 100 miles of steep georgia-alabama border gravel in Franklin, Georgia.
